flows.name: Scan pipeline (collect → score → interpret → report)
flows.summary: The read-only scan: fan out four collectors, score+correlate, synthesize recommendations, render a ranked report. Never mutates.

steps.summary: Invoke scan (optionally --json / --interactive).
Fan out collectors; a failing collector is reported as a gap, never silence.
Shell out to launchctl/plutil/codesign/spctl/ps/lsof/sqlite3.
Group evidence by subject, sum weights, correlation multiplier, suppress allowlisted, fire tripwires.
Rule-based verdict + category + recommendation per finding.
Executive summary + ranked actionable findings; Monitor tier counted, not dumped.
Ranked report (or --json).

guarantees: Missing signals reported as gaps (fail loud)
failureBehavior: A collector that cannot read its source prints a gap line; the scan still completes with the signals it has
verification: manual `counterspy scan` on a real Mac
knownGaps: False-positive volume on developer machines (see risk-false-positive-volume)

flows.name: Consented quarantine (disable → move → manifest)
flows.summary: The only mutating flow: on per-item approval, disable the launch item and MOVE its artifacts into a reversible quarantine, recording a manifest.
flows.trigger: operator answers y to a finding in `scan --interactive`

steps.summary: Per-item consent (y/N/q).
Refuse allowlisted/protected paths; bootout; move artifacts into the quarantine mirror.
Quarantined to ~/CounterSpyQuarantine/<ts>; reversible via `restore`.

guarantees: Partial failures still write a manifest so nothing is orphaned
failureBehavior: Refuses Apple-signed/allowlisted and protected system paths; on a mid-way move failure, stops and records the partial manifest
knownGaps: A live process with no on-disk artifact cannot be quarantined (surfaced for manual action)

flows.name: Flow inspection (i → /dev/bpf capture → honest verdict)
flows.summary: On demand, capture one selected Exfiltration flow with a native /dev/bpf tap scoped to its 4-tuple and return an honest coverage verdict (readable plaintext, TLS ciphertext, or cleartext binary) — never decrypting, keeping bytes local and ephemeral.
flows.trigger: operator presses `i` on a flow in the Exfiltration view

steps.summary: Press i on a selected flow.
Pure update queues InspectReq; the run loop performs the I/O (root capture off the UI thread).
Open a /dev/bpf capture scoped to the flow and read up to maxPackets.
Read frames from /dev/bpf (BIOCSETIF/BIOCSETF filter, link-layer strip).
Captured frames for the scoped flow.
Correlate both directions; classify coverage honestly (plaintext / TLS-ciphertext / cleartext-binary) + extract SNI.
Honest verdict + rendered bytes (text or hexdump; ciphertext withheld).
Render the coverage verdict via the TUI; secrets masked until reveal (v).

guarantees: Least-privilege BPF filter scoped to the one flow
failureBehavior: A capture failure is surfaced as an honest verdict (e.g. 'relaunch with sudo'), never a false 'clean'.
verification: root smoke test (COUNTERSPY_LIVE_CAPTURE=1): loopback TLS SNI + filter-drop
knownGaps: Destination NAMES (SNI/DNS) not yet threaded into the tree (issue #3)

flows.name: TLS intercept (arm → system proxy → CONNECT → decrypt → publish → console → disarm)
flows.summary: Consented, read-only decryption of the user's own outbound TLS: install a local CA, register as the system HTTPS proxy, terminate each CONNECT tunnel with a per-SNI leaf, re-dial the verified upstream, relay unmodified, capture + mask the plaintext into per-message InterceptedMessage events, publish them to a live unix socket and/or a rotating 0600 log, and ingest them into the console's Exfiltration view via `console --intercept` — all reverted on exit. Verified end-to-end on macOS 2026-07-16.
flows.trigger: operator runs `sudo counterspy intercept` and consents

steps.summary: Run `intercept`; confirm the trusted-CA install + system-proxy change (y/N, default No).
Load-or-create the CA; install trust, THEN register the system proxy (teardown registered first so any interrupt still disarms).
Add the CA as a System-keychain trusted root (security) and point each network service's HTTPS proxy at 127.0.0.1 (networksetup), capturing each PRIOR setting.
A proxy-honoring app opens a CONNECT tunnel, NAMING its destination — authoritative, replacing the disproved pf origdest lookup.

Terminate the client TLS with a per-SNI leaf, re-dial the upstream verified against the CONNECT authority, relay unmodified, and DecodeCleartext + Redact the captured plaintext into per-message InterceptedMessage events (request/response correlated in FIFO order).
Publish the masked flow to the live unix socket (chowned to the invoking user) and/or the rotating 0600 log.
As the ordinary user, open the console and ingest the decrypted stream (live socket, or a captured --log file) into the Exfiltration view; counterspy's own relay dials are excluded from that view.

Per-app decrypted-message summaries in the Exfiltration zoom, with honest empty states and a marker on destinations whose TLS was decrypted; content only for 'decrypted' status — pinned/opaque/error explain why there is none.
Teardown restores each service's prior proxy setting then removes the CA trust (reverse order), exactly once, on exit/panic/signal.

guarantees: Read-only mirror: relayed bytes are never modified; upstream verified against the CONNECT authority
Secrets Redact-masked before any flow is published; only 'decrypted' flows carry plaintext
Arm is always reversible: proxy + trust reverted on exit, panic, and signal; --uninstall self-heals
failureBehavior: A cert-pinned client that rejects the leaf is shown honestly as 'pinned' (bypassed, not decrypted)
A connection whose CONNECT cannot be read publishes a FlowError — never dropped silently
Any arming failure rolls back what was installed and fails loud; a revert failure is reported, never silent
observability: honest per-flow status (decrypted / pinned / opaque / error)
verification: root smoke test 2026-07-16: live decrypt of system traffic; proxy + trust restored on exit
knownGaps: COOPERATIVE: software ignoring the system proxy is not intercepted (needs a NetworkExtension transparent proxy — later phase)
Redact/block of outbound payloads deferred to Phase 3 (this phase is decrypt/visibility only)
curl does not honor the macOS system proxy (use `curl -x`); browsers/CFNetwork apps do
